entries.rationale: Atlas-reviewed creature glossary counterpart. Foundry PF2e 28d9d156f252d084371d994dc359509b49eadf18 retains the Bestiary Attack of Opportunity and Monster Core Reactive Strike entries in the same glossary. Their selected English ability texts agree (SHA-256 6366c8de03d73b324eae84473f9008fd53573ebd1dd13e871efbf57f238eedd9). This correspondence is an Atlas assertion about those exact glossary entries, not the class-feature journal's general-action link or a claim that all identically named actions are interchangeable. Ordinary errata does not alone withdraw counterpart meaning; current exact endpoints, action family and glossary scope are required.
